steps.en: Install OCRmyPDF, Tesseract and the language packs you need
steps.zh: 装好 OCRmyPDF、Tesseract 和需要的语言包
steps.code: apt install ocrmypdf · brew install ocrmypdf

steps.en: Run it on a scanned PDF, naming the languages and cleanup options
steps.zh: 对扫描 PDF 运行它，指定语言和清理选项

steps.en: Rasterizes each page and runs Tesseract on it, pages in parallel across CPU cores
steps.zh: 把每页渲染成图交给 Tesseract 识别，多核并行

steps.en: Places the recognized words as an invisible text layer under the untouched page image
steps.zh: 把识别出的字作为隐形文字层垫在原图下方，原图不动

steps.en: Optimizes images, converts to PDF/A when it can, and validates the output file
steps.zh: 压缩图像，能转就转成 PDF/A，并校验输出文件

value.en: The scan looks exactly the same but is now searchable, copyable and archive-ready
value.zh: 扫描件外观完全不变，但能搜索、能复制、能长期归档

sources: https://github.com/ocrmypdf/OCRmyPDF#main-features (text placed below the image, PDF/A, image optimization, validation, multi-core)
